warps.label: Creature Containment

unlock_milestones.title: Containment Restored
unlock_milestones.text: The containment lift answers again. The tower is ready to shelter magical creatures instead of merely studying their remains.

warps.locked_note: The containment lift stays inert. Lyra will not have creatures in a tower whose own beds are refusing to root — show the greenhouse can be brought back first.
warps.required_journal_hint: wake the stalled propagation bed with a restorative

gather_nodes.name: Cultivated Sunleaf
gather_nodes.note: A sheltered patch that keeps medicinal herbs alive between seasons.

gather_nodes.name: Glasshouse Moss
gather_nodes.note: Condensation and old wards make the greenhouse stones bloom softly.

gather_nodes.name: Dew Slug
gather_nodes.note: These gentle slugs gather where greenhouse glass sweats at dawn.

apply_targets.name: Stalled Propagation Bed
apply_targets.untreated_note: The end bed has not taken. The cuttings are alive and doing nothing, which Brin says is worse than dead.
apply_targets.treated_note: The bed drinks it in and the stalled cuttings put out root inside the hour. Brin will want to see this.

completion_milestones.title: The Bed That Would Not Take
completion_milestones.text: The end propagation bed had been alive and refusing to root for a season. It took a restorative poured straight onto the soil rather than anything anybody drank, which is the first time the tower's work has gone into the ground instead of into a person.
